[[File:Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Shannon Baksa''' (later '''Shannon Lynn McRandle''', née Jones) is the model Decipher cast as Mara Jade. She was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Her likeness is on [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] from [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] and on the Light Side [[Mara Jade]] from Virtual Set 17. She is on the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000), the first official flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade.<ref name="databank">[https://web.archive.org/web/20110807051128/http://starwars.com/databank/character/marajadeskywalker/index.html Mara Jade Skywalker], Star Wars Databank (Wayback 7 August 2011)</ref><ref name="tfn">[http://www.theforce.net/videogames/story/Shannon_Baksa_is_Mara_Jade_78191.asp Shannon Baksa is Mara Jade], TheForce.net (12 November 1999) Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160101152549/http://www.theforce.net/videogames/story/Shannon_Baksa_is_Mara_Jade_78191.asp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-x">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1828839249443262568 @swccg], 28 August 2024 Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009005326/https://x.com/swccg/status/1828839249443262568 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wook-47">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_47 Star Wars Insider 47], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170620212824/http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_47 Wayback, 20 June 2017].</ref>

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Shannon Baksa signing.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Baksa signing at DecipherCon 2000, 6 October 2000]]

Decipher's DecipherCon '99 guest bio called her Star Wars' "Mara Jade": a professional model and make-up artist, cast by Decipher, who would sign photographs at the convention.<ref name="bio">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/shannonbio.html Shannon Baksa — Star Wars' "Mara Jade"], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000304010455/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/shannonbio.html Internet Archive]</ref> The bio said she was a Texas native with a B.S. in Public Relations from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and a lifelong Star Wars fan who had dressed as Princess Leia for Halloween. After she was cast, she read Timothy Zahn's Star Wars novels to learn the character.<ref name="bio" />

== Convention guest ==

At DecipherCon '99 (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach) she signed Friday 1–3pm and Saturday/Sunday 12–2pm. Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that she appeared as Mara Jade in full costume.<ref name="sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher photographed her in costume with a lightsaber.<ref name="sat63">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat63.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat63], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Mara, put the lightsaber down, please. I just want your autograph." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303121025/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat63.html Internet Archive]</ref>

At DecipherCon 2000 (5–8 October 2000, Kissimmee) she returned with [[Michonne Bourriague]]. She signed autographs on 6 October and took part in the magazine feature "Who is Mara Jade?" on 8 October.

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Who is Mara Jade.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Baksa as Mara Jade at DecipherCon 2000, 8 October 2000]]

== Star Wars Insider 47 ==

[[File:Star Wars Insider 47 Mara Jade cover.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Baksa on the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47.<ref name="wook-47" />]]

The full feature, page scans, and SWCCG quotes are on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]].

Lucasfilm's official fan magazine put Baksa on the cover of issue 47 (street date 3 January 2000) with a photograph from Decipher's [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] shoot. Jon Bradley Snyder edited the 82-page issue, published by The Fan Club, Inc. / Fantastic Media (ISSN 1041-5122). Mark Atkinson of Otto Studios took the cover photograph.<ref name="wook-47" /><ref name="sw-streets">[https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news20000103.html New Star Wars Insider #47 Hits the Streets], StarWars.com (3 January 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20051205134152/https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news20000103.html Wayback, 5 December 2005].</ref><ref name="fab">[[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]</ref>

[[File:Mara Jade Flesh and Blood.jpg|thumb|left|420px|Scott Chernoff's "Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood", pages 52–53.<ref name="wook-fab">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mara_Jade:_Flesh_and_Blood Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250418063630/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mara_Jade:_Flesh_and_Blood Wayback, 18 April 2025].</ref>]]

StarWars.com previewed the cover on 27 October 1999. Mara would appear on her own Decipher CCG card, but ''Insider'' would print those images first, with an interview with Timothy Zahn. The 3 January 2000 street notice named "the woman tapped to become the first 'flesh and blood' version of Mara, Shannon Baksa."<ref name="sw-preview">[https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news19991027c/index.html Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood], StarWars.com (27 October 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110703035710/https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news19991027c/index.html Wayback, 3 July 2011].</ref><ref name="sw-streets" />

Chernoff interviewed Baksa and Decipher creative director Dan Burns. Burns said Decipher was working on Enhanced Jabba's Palace, with Mara as a Power Card, when he thought of "the possibility of fleshing her out". Baksa read the comic and the first three Zahn novels and wore green contacts over gray eyes. She described Mara as "kind of quiet and more observant rather than jumping into the middle of everything." Burns called the shoot "a really big production for just a little card" that had to pass through Lucasfilm.<ref name="fab" />

== Likeness on SWCCG cards ==

Decipher hired Baksa to pose as Mara for a number of card images, starting with the live-action photo for Enhanced Jabba's Palace. Many later products use her likeness for Mara.<ref name="databank" />

[[File:EJP-D-marajadetheemperorshand.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]], Enhanced Jabba's Palace]]
[[File:V17-L-marajade.gif|thumb|right|200px|[[Mara Jade]], Virtual Set 17]]

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] — Enhanced Jabba's Palace premium (die-cut pack with [[Bossk With Mortar Gun]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]])
* The same title as a Reflections II foil
* Oversized Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand convention promo (spend $20 at the Decipher store)
* Oversized group promo: [[Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde|Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde]] (same store promo)
* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] — Virtual Set 26 reprint of the same photograph
* Virtual Block 4 [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber (Dark)|Mara Jade With Lightsaber]] overlay uses the same Enhanced Jabba's Palace photograph
* Light Side [[Mara Jade]] (Virtual Set 17)<ref name="pc-x" />
* Site card "Shannon Baksa (Mara Jade) and Jeremy Bulloch (Boba Fett)" in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #48, [[All Decked Out (Star Wars Insider)|All Decked Out]] (April 2000)<ref name="insider48">Rich Handley, "All Decked Out", ''Star Wars Insider'' #48 (April 2000), pp. 78–79. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-56b702/page/n81/mode/2up ''Star Wars Insider'' 48], Internet Archive.</ref>

[[File:Shannon Baksa and Jeremy Bulloch Star Wars Insider 48 site card.jpg|thumb|left|280px|''Star Wars Insider'' #48 site card with [[Jeremy Bulloch]]. Photo: Rich Handley.]]

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Signed 5×7 oversized [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]]]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand scale.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Oversized and regular-size [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]]]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde signed.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Oversized group promo signed by Baksa, Michael A. Stackpole and Timothy Zahn]]

Creative director Dan Burns ran a local-model search; she later appeared as a Decipher convention representative with a lit lightsaber. ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 printed her green Light Side costume on page 55, captioned "LIGHT SIDE: Mara Jade, Jedi Knight". Burns said the outfit was "meant to depict Mara's light side (which will be issued later as another Power Card in the game)." Decipher shot the costume but never printed the card. The Players Committee used that work for the Light Side [[Mara Jade]] in Virtual Set 17.<ref name="set17">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/light-side-mara-jade-virtual-set-17-spoiler/ Light Side Mara Jade, Virtual Set 17 spoiler], Players Committee (4 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230303022134/https://www.starwarsccg.org/light-side-mara-jade-virtual-set-17-spoiler/ Wayback, 3 March 2023].</ref><ref name="fab" />

== Interviews ==

=== NanashiStudios, 10 December 2021 ===

[[File:Shannon McRandle 2021 interview.png|thumb|right|280px|Shannon McRandle, Mara Jade]]

In a December 2021 video interview<ref name="mcrandle">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOX0cT3ukR8 Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (10 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-oOX0cT3ukR8 Internet Archive].</ref> she introduces herself as Shannon McRandle, formerly Shannon Baksa, hired as the living face of Mara Jade for Decipher's ''Star Wars'' game cards. A ''Star Wars Insider'' poll had made Mara the fan-favorite character who had never been on film. The casting call asked for a 5'9–5'10 redhead, dancer-type, strong. The photographer already shooting the project brought her in before the call; Decipher then cancelled the open casting.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She describes herself as an old-school board-game player. Her first meeting was at Decipher, then a comic shop to learn about Mara. Decipher had mock-ups of comic covers and artist ideas; Mara had never had one look. She read the first two Zahn novels before the second interview. For the shoot she lightened her hair orangey-red and wore green contacts.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She calls Mara the first female character who was almost the opposite of Leia: a bad guy you fall in love with. On the work itself: "if it had just been that one day that one card and a couple of DecipherCons I would have been ecstatic." Being Mara introduced her to the wider ''Star Wars'' world; she dates that span as 20 of her 50 years. She says she would not call herself iconic: "Mara Jade is iconic and to have been able to stand in her boots for a moment."<ref name="mcrandle" />
